answer: Proof of identity should leave the screen and enter the workshop. Each node is handed a small annealing coil, violet in the catalog list, that must burn jade dust for one full hour before it drops a lotus-seal attestation, and the burn cannot be forked or cloned. A sybil farmer buying fifty coils pays fifty hours of furnace time, iron and fuel, while one honest builder simply waits her turn at the kiln. Attesters read the burn curves, so ten identical curves submitted in one night look like a forgery; the hardware cannot be wished away, only waited out.
